scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/api && npm run lint --workspace apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.prisma:validate: npx prisma validate && npx prisma migrate status
scripts.release:check: npm run repo:hygiene && npm run verify && npm audit --audit-level=high && docker compose config --quiet
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run prisma:validate && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
